Axiom shared layer

One palette and one component set for all nineteen dockable views. Every file in this delivery carries this block byte identical, which is a workaround rather than the fix: in Axiom it belongs at :root in styles.css, declared once, with every feature stylesheet referencing rather than redeclaring it.

The problem this replaces

The renderer's stylesheets today declare 108 distinct tokens 451 times. --accent, --focus, --ok, --warn, --bad, --raised and --sunken are each declared thirteen times, in seven private palettes scoped to .details-pane, .find-panel, .adaptive-pane[data-pane-id="quality"], .entity-context-menu.chrome-menu and three more. The original styles.css, 102 KB of it, declares fifteen tokens in total. So the six rebuilt panes agree because they were specified from the same numbers, not because they share anything. Change the accent and you edit it in thirteen places, and any pane outside those seven keeps the old look.

The hoist

This block is read out of this page's own live stylesheet at load, so it cannot drift from the CSS above it. Paste it at :root in styles.css, then delete the palette from every feature stylesheet and let them inherit.

Geometry

A view's entire chrome is one action row. There is no second band, and no standing explanatory paragraph at any size. These are the shared constants; a view may declare its own budgets on top, never instead.

The presentation ladder

From docs/adaptive-pane-ux.md, unchanged. No file in this delivery introduces a threshold of its own; an action row that cannot fit overflows by measurement instead.

PresentationEntryWhat a view does
Expandedw 600+, h 400+Full configuration and working content
Narroww under 600Single column; secondary actions overflow
Shallowh under 400Horizontal header; remaining height goes to the body
Narrow and shallowbothNarrow structure, shallow priority, one section at a time
Recoveryw under 240, h under 210 narrow or 180Identity and Maximise pane; contents stay mounted and inert

Exits carry 16 pixels of hysteresis at 616 and 416 so a pane near a boundary does not flicker. Graph is exempt by name and keeps its canvas at every size.

The rules every view in this delivery holds

One action rowA view's entire chrome is one row of --h-bar. No second toolbar band, and no standing explanatory paragraph at any size.
Declare your sizeEvery region declares its own height and width budget. A region that declares neither takes whatever the container offers, in whichever direction the container is generous, which is the defect behind both the Find editor and the Quality settings block.
Measure, do not breakActions overflow when they do not fit, in one order that never reshuffles. Breakpoints are for the body, not the toolbar.
Every fact onceA count stated in the header is not restated in the body. A headline does not echo a value visible in the field above it.
Empty space is correctA view with little to show is reporting that honestly. Stretching a region to fill the pane is a defect, not a fix.
Say why it is unavailableA disabled control carries its reason. A control that is structurally impossible withdraws; a measurable zero is shown as zero.
Never colour aloneStatus pairs colour with a word and a shape. Selection pairs tint with a leading bar.
Help is not furnitureExplanatory text is the empty state's own content or a named disclosure, never a permanent band.

What this is not

These are prototypes, not the numbered normative specs the earlier six surfaces each received. No capture of the running app exists for any of the twelve views rebuilt here, so they are designed from src/renderer and docs/ rather than from observed defects. Where a file supersedes a documented sentence it quotes that sentence in its own notes.
